## What changed

Describe the bounded change and the problem it solves.

Small, focused fixes do not need a project-evolution record. Complete the last
section only when changing ChatGPT behavior, bundled knowledge scope, evaluation
semantics, or a public performance claim.

## Evidence

- [ ] Project tests pass
- [ ] Staged installation self-check passes
- [ ] Python sources compile
- [ ] `self_check.py` passes
- [ ] Changed behavior has a regression test
- [ ] Performance claims include workload, baseline, correctness, measurement, and environment evidence
- [ ] No host-level setting was changed without explicit authorization

## Project evolution, when applicable

- [ ] The public change must still stand if any private validation statement is removed
- [ ] No private material, internal address, workload, trace, weight, source, or image is attached
- [ ] The Evaluation Definition was frozen before the reported result
- [ ] The claim is no broader than the recorded evidence
- [ ] This pull request does not automatically admit knowledge, merge, or release the change
